vectors.notes: P is the bytes 00..1f. Also docs/PROTOCOL.md line 541 (agrees). Reproduced in tools/discovery_crypto.py.

vectors.description: Migration: L_(d+1) for P = 00..1f and day 20737
Owner's own role-0 salt / RDI for epoch 1990656 using the migrated L_d of day 20736 as the salt key
Delivery window: a migrated window holds yesterday..day+27 at the first epoch of a day; a delivery is today and the next 27 days (28 leases); an incomplete window delivers nothing

Day-key window rule: fresh window = today..today+27; same day changes nothing; the first epoch of the next day adds day+28 and keeps yesterday; one epoch later yesterday is deleted; a phone off >1 month gets a whole new window
vectors.notes: Keys are independent random 32-byte values per day (no ratchet from other days); behavioural.

vectors.description: Recognition window: a contact whose lease sender is 2 epochs ahead (skew +2) recognises role 0 IDs for sender epochs centre-1..centre+1 (6 table entries = 3 epochs x roles 0 and 1) and nothing at centre-2 or for role 2
vectors.computed_by: tools/discovery_crypto.py (RDI derivation with the lease key L_d as salt key); table sizes 6 and 22 and the hit/miss outcomes are the test's literal assertions (the 22 is for a skew older than 14 days: window +-8 clipped to days the lease covers)
vectors.notes: Recognition (RV3): a received lease lets the holder recompute the sender's IDs for [sender epoch - 1, +1] around the learned clock skew; a lease does not resolve IDs before its first day (RD5).

vectors.description: Contact lease skew is clamped to +-30 days of epochs (2880)
vectors.notes: MAX_SKEW_EPOCHS = 30 * epochsPerDay (96) = 2880 (source PresenceLeases.kt:263). Receiver rules: higher generation replaces, equal merges, lower is ignored.

vectors.notes: Local-only format (sealed by the Keystore AES-GCM wrapper); included so a second implementation can read a migrated store. Version 1 stores held one long-lived key P instead of the key block ('BPS1' | 01 | generation u32 | P(32) | contacts) and are converted once.

description: Presence leases (Phase 2 recognition): independent daily keys L_d, the migration derivation from a long-lived key P, day numbering, the 28-day delivery and the recognition window. Lease key (migration only) = HMAC-SHA256(P, 'BluetoothVideoMesh/Discovery/Lease/2' || NUL || u32 day). day = floor(epoch * 900 / 86400) (96 epochs per day). The sealed on-disk store is local, not a wire format.
